SANITY_PROJECT_ID.description: Which project to read. Public because the client needs it in the browser; Sanity's security guidance is written about tokens and never about this. The name is convention.

SANITY_DATASET.description: Which dataset within the project, usually production. An identifier, and in the browser for the same reason. The name is convention.

SANITY_API_READ_TOKEN.description: Sanity says a personal token gives complete access as your user, and to use a scoped robot token for a service instead. It never states that a read-scoped token is safe in a browser, so this one is not treated as public.
